cards.typed_words:
POETRY COMPETITION
Tom Jensen
(978) 745-1496

---

Dear Professors and poetry admirers,
My name is Tom Jensen and my telephone number is (978) 745  -  1496. You can reach me by email at bobdylanjr@yahoo.com. This is not an official portfolio or anything like that...just some things I pulled off from my greatest hits collection. I'm a 21year old night student at Salem State College. I'm a Communications major with a journalism concentration and an English minor. I discovered I loved writing songs and poems about two years ago and now I consider it an obsession. I work full time during the day and go to school at night so I don't have as much time for poetry as I'd like. I still squeeze it in and make sure I write or try to write everyday. I got a 3.85 GPA last semester so there's not a whole lotta extra room in my life. Hopefully someday I will be able to make a living of it but for now I try to keep it as big a part of my life as possible.

I have lived quite a lot during my 21 years and I feel that I have a lot to offer the world and my poetry is my way of capturing certain feelings I have and also certain parts of my life. I think it is amazing to look back at my poetry and see how it generally coincides with my lifestyle at which I wrote it. I was once a fat loser with no self-esteem. I then entered in with the wrong crowd and started smoking cigarettes and drinking and all that. I found a social role but it was not what I wanted as an image. I quite smoking cigarettes and played sports later in high school and trimmed down from 218 to 174 and I found myself. My social life was booming and I was very happy. My grades suffered and I graduated high school with a 2.00GPA. I went to college and had no interest in grades only the parties.
